statement: Request changes: one critical architecture violation (an upward import from services/ into components/) blocks the layering invariant, and the new service's tests are happy-path only. Fix the import; add a failure-path test.

findings.description: Upward import: services/ imports from components/ (`from components.router import route`). Dependencies must flow downward only (Invariant #1); services/ must not import components/.
findings.fix_suggestion: Invert the dependency — pass the routed value in as a parameter from the orchestration layer, or move the shared type into trust/.
